# a PF00549 profile-HMM Viterbi survey of 125 AllF-family and 41 succinyl-CoA
# ligase alpha sequences. Nothing here is re-derived or estimated.

SCS  = [0.878, 0.9512, 0.9268, 1.0, 1.0, 0.9512, 1.0, 0.9756, 0.9512, 0.878, 0.7805, 0.6341, 0.3415, 0.7317, 0.4878, 0.7561, 0.3171, 0.2683, 0.9024, 0.4634, 1.0, 0.8049, 0.7073, 0.878, 0.4146, 0.7561, 1.0, 0.9268, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 0.9512, 0.5366, 0.4878, 1.0, 0.6585, 0.4878, 0.8049, 0.5854, 0.878, 0.439, 0.7073, 0.3902, 0.2927, 0.9512, 0.3171, 0.3415, 1.0, 0.561, 0.561, 1.0, 0.5122, 0.7073, 0.6098, 0.5854, 0.6829, 0.9024, 1.0, 1.0, 0.9512, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 0.439, 0.7805, 1.0, 0.9512, 0.5854, 0.9512, 0.9756, 0.4634, 0.3902, 0.7805, 0.7073, 0.2683, 0.3902, 0.2439, 0.2683, 0.561, 0.6098, 0.8293, 0.8293, 0.7805, 1.0, 0.8293, 0.8293, 0.4634, 0.6829, 0.8293, 0.6829, 1.0, 0.2195, 0.878, 1.0, 0.9756, 0.6341, 0.9512, 0.8049, 0.9024, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 0.9756, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 0.7805, 0.5854, 0.9512, 0.8049, 0.7317, 0.9512, 0.7317, 0.9268, 0.439, 0.3902, 1.0, 0.3902, 0.3659, 0.7073, 0.9268, 0.4146, 0.3659, 0.7317, 1.0, 0.7561, 0.3902]
ALLF, SCS = np.array(ALLF), np.array(SCS)

# per-column profiles at the sites of interest (printed by the same script)
sites = [
    ("col 3\nAllF T338\nSucD R153",   0.288, 0.9268, "S 28.8 / C 28.0 / T 23.2", "R 92.7"),
    ("col 4\nAllF G339\nSucD S154",   1.000, 1.0000, "G 100",                    "S 100"),
    ("col 5\nAllF G340\nSucD G155",   1.000, 1.0000, "G 100",                    "G 100"),
    ("col 6\nAllF T341\nSucD T156",   0.976, 0.9512, "T 97.6",                   "T 95.1"),
    ("col 102\nAllF Q467\nSucD H247", 0.912, 1.0000, "Q 91.2",                   "H 100"),
]

fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(14, 5.2))

# ---- panel A: conservation at the power helix and the catalytic column -------
x = np.arange(len(sites)); w = 0.38
a_f = [s[1] for s in sites]; a_s = [s[2] for s in sites]
ax[0].bar(x - w/2, a_f, w, color="#c0392b", label="AllF family (n=125)")
ax[0].bar(x + w/2, a_s, w, color="#2c6fbb", label="SCS alpha family (n=41)")
for i, s in enumerate(sites):
    ax[0].text(i - w/2, s[1] + 0.015, s[3], ha="center", va="bottom", fontsize=7.5, rotation=90, color="#c0392b")
    ax[0].text(i + w/2, s[2] + 0.015, s[4], ha="center", va="bottom", fontsize=7.5, rotation=90, color="#2c6fbb")
ax[0].axhline(np.median(ALLF), ls="--", lw=1, color="#c0392b", alpha=0.6)
ax[0].text(4.45, np.median(ALLF) + 0.01, "AllF family median\nacross all 127 columns (0.53)",
           fontsize=7.5, color="#c0392b", ha="right", va="bottom")
ax[0].set_xticks(x); ax[0].set_xticklabels([s[0] for s in sites], fontsize=8)
ax[0].set_ylabel("conservation (frequency of the most common residue)")
ax[0].set_ylim(0, 1.32); ax[0].set_yticks(np.arange(0, 1.01, 0.2))
ax[0].set_title("A  Anion-binding power helix is retained in the AllF family,\nthe catalytic histidine is replaced by a conserved glutamine", fontsize=10)
ax[0].legend(loc="upper left", fontsize=8, framealpha=0.9)

# ---- panel B: background control --------------------------------------------
bins = np.arange(0, 1.0001, 0.05)
ax[1].hist(ALLF, bins=bins, color="#c0392b", alpha=0.55, label="AllF family, 127 PF00549 columns")
ax[1].hist(SCS,  bins=bins, color="#2c6fbb", alpha=0.45, label="SCS alpha family, same columns")
for v, lab, col, dy in [(1.000, "G339, G340", "#8e2b20", 15.5),
                        (0.976, "T341", "#8e2b20", 11.5),
                        (0.912, "Q467", "#8e2b20", 7.5),
                        (0.288, "T338", "#8e2b20", 7.5)]:
    ax[1].annotate(lab, xy=(v, dy), xytext=(v - 0.17, dy + 5.5), fontsize=8, color=col,
                   arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->", color=col, lw=1))
ax[1].set_xlabel("conservation per PF00549 match column")
ax[1].set_ylabel("number of columns")
ax[1].set_title("B  Control: only 9/127 columns (7.1%) are invariant in the AllF family\n"
                "against 28/127 (22.0%) in SCS alpha, so 100% conservation is informative", fontsize=10)
ax[1].legend(fontsize=8)
ax[1].text(0.02, ax[1].get_ylim()[1]*0.62,
           "His389 sits in an insertion, not a match column.\n"
           "It is present in 125/125 AllF-family sequences,\n"
           "where the median match column reaches only 0.53.",
           fontsize=8, va="top",
           bbox=dict(boxstyle="round,pad=0.4", fc="#fff6e6", ec="#d9a441"))

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

print("AllF family: invariant columns %d/127 (%.1f%%), median conservation %.3f"
      % ((ALLF == 1.0).sum(), 100*(ALLF == 1.0).mean(), np.median(ALLF)))
print("SCS alpha  : invariant columns %d/127 (%.1f%%), median conservation %.3f"
      % ((SCS == 1.0).sum(), 100*(SCS == 1.0).mean(), np.median(SCS)))
for name, f, s, pf, ps in sites:
    pct = 100.0 * (ALLF < f).mean()
    print("%-28s AllF-fam %.3f (%.0fth pct) [%s]   SCS-fam %.3f [%s]"
          % (name.replace("\n", " "), f, pct, pf, s, ps))
